entries.title: Numbers 15:2
segments: Ye; the children of those who were to die in the wilderness.

The land of your habitations; Canaan. In the wilderness, which was a land not sown nor planted with vineyards, they would not all be able to comply with these requirements. 
 
Though ever so many prove unfaithful to God, and cut themselves off from his blessings, it will not annul his faithfulness, or render his promises of no effect.

entries.title: Numbers 15:4
segments: A tenth-deal--a hin; an ephah contained between thirty-four and thirty-five quarts.  A tenth-deal was the tenth, and a hin the seventh part of an ophah.

entries.title: Numbers 15:14
segments: As ye do, so he shall do; not only to prevent the introduction of heathenish rites, but to convey the idea that there is one religion and one way of salvation for Jews and Gentiles.

entries.title: Numbers 15:16
segments: Persons of all nations may have access to God through Jesus Christ, and by faith in him may be freely pardoned, sanctified, and saved; whether they be Jews or Gentiles, high or low, bond or free.

entries.title: Numbers 15:21
segments: God is the giver of all our mercies, and in partaking of them we should gratefully acknowledge and adore him.

entries.title: Numbers 15:24
segments: According to the manner; the manner above directed for the meat-offering,

entries.title: Numbers 15:26
segments: The law of God is exceeding broad.  We often violate it through inattention, without at the time being aware of it; and are in continual need of pardoning mercy through Christ.

entries.title: Numbers 15:28
segments: Sinneth ignorantly; through carelessness or inattention, violating some law without at the time being aware of it.

entries.title: Numbers 15:30
segments:
Doeth aught presumptuously; violates a known law by design, and in defiance of Jehovah. 
 
The open transgression of known divine laws is a reproach upon their Author, and brings upon the soul his awful displeasure.

entries.title: Numbers 15:31
segments: His iniquity shall be upon him; shall rest upon him unforgiven, requiring his punishment.

entries.title: Numbers 15:32
segments: Gathered sticks upon the sabbath-day; presumptuously, in open defiance of God and his laws.

entries.title: Numbers 15:36
segments: Wilful sabbath-breaking, in opposition to the known command of God, is a sin of presumption, and exposes those who practise it to be cut off for ever from his favor.

entries.title: Numbers 15:38
segments: A ribbon of blue; to distinguish them as the true worshippers of God from their heathen neighbors, and to remind them of the law of God and their duty to keep it.  In our Lord's day the Pharisees made this precept the occasion of vain ostentation; keeping it in the letter, but breaking it in the spirit.

entries.title: Numbers 15:39
segments: The disciples of Christ should be continually mindful of their high calling; and should endeavor to be so distinguished from the men of this world in their daily spirit and conduct, that all may recognize them as the true children of God.

entries.title: Numbers 15:40
segments: All the directions of God are designed and adapted to make his people holy, to remind them of their obligations, and lead them so to keep his commandments as to receive the blessings of his everlasting love.
